"""Typed seed validation without output side effects."""

import json
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

from pydantic import TypeAdapter, ValidationError

from .models import (
    ApprovalRule,
    EraTemplateItemRow,
    ObligationRow,
    PermitRow,
    SeedData,
    SeedIssue,
    SiteRow,
)
from .readers import CsvRecord, read_csv

REQUIRED_HEADERS = {
    "sites.csv": ("code", "division_code", "name", "env_contact"),
    "site_permits.csv": ("site_code", "permit_type", "applicable", "grade", "detail", "items", "quantity", "status"),
    "obligation_types.csv": (
        "code", "media", "title", "legal_basis", "source", "frequency", "times_per_period",
        "due_rule", "applies_when", "anchor", "evidence_required", "evidence_hint", "verified", "notes",
    ),
    "era_template_items.csv": (
        "division", "seq", "process", "activity", "aspect", "impact", "media", "condition",
        "legal_related", "legal_basis", "likelihood", "severity", "existing_controls", "lesson_ref",
    ),
}
REQUIRED_FIELDS = {
    "sites.csv": ("code", "division_code", "name"),
    "site_permits.csv": ("site_code", "permit_type", "applicable", "status"),
    "obligation_types.csv": ("code", "media", "title", "source", "frequency", "times_per_period", "due_rule", "applies_when", "anchor", "evidence_required", "verified"),
    "era_template_items.csv": ("division", "seq", "process", "activity", "aspect", "impact", "media", "condition", "legal_related", "likelihood", "severity"),
}


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class _ParsedRecord[T]:
    row: int
    value: T


def _empty_issues(file_name: str, record: CsvRecord, required: tuple[str, ...]) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    """Return distinct empty and whitespace-only diagnostics for required cells."""
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for field in required:
        value = record.values.get(field)
        if value == "":
            issues.append(SeedIssue(file_name, record.row, field, value, "required value is empty"))
        elif value is not None and value.strip() == "":
            issues.append(SeedIssue(file_name, record.row, field, value, "required value is whitespace only"))
    return tuple(issues)


def _normalized(values: dict[str, str | None]) -> dict[str, str | None]:
    """Normalize optional text after empty-vs-whitespace validation has run."""
    normalized: dict[str, str | None] = {}
    for key, value in values.items():
        if value is None:
            normalized[key] = None
        else:
            trimmed = value.strip()
            normalized[key] = trimmed or None
    return normalized


def _model_issues(
    file_name: str,
    row: int,
    error: ValidationError,
    values: dict[str, str | None],
) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    """Convert Pydantic diagnostics into stable operator-facing issues."""
    return tuple(
        SeedIssue(file_name, row, str(detail["loc"][0]), values.get(str(detail["loc"][0])), detail["msg"])
        for detail in error.errors()
    )


def _parse_csv[T](
    root: Path,
    file_name: str,
    model: Callable[..., T],
) -> tuple[tuple[_ParsedRecord[T], ...], tuple[SeedIssue, ...]]:
    """Read and parse one CSV master using its model constructor."""
    result = read_csv(root / file_name, REQUIRED_HEADERS[file_name])
    issues = list(result.issues)
    rows: list[_ParsedRecord[T]] = []
    for record in result.records:
        empties = _empty_issues(file_name, record, REQUIRED_FIELDS[file_name])
        issues.extend(empties)
        try:
            parsed = model(**_normalized(record.values))
            if not empties:
                rows.append(_ParsedRecord(record.row, parsed))
        except ValidationError as error:
            issues.extend(_model_issues(file_name, record.row, error, record.values))
    return tuple(rows), tuple(issues)


def _json_issue(root: Path) -> tuple[tuple[ApprovalRule, ...], tuple[SeedIssue, ...]]:
    """Parse approval rules separately from CSV master inputs."""
    path = root / "approval_rules.json"
    try:
        return TypeAdapter(tuple[ApprovalRule, ...]).validate_json(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")), ()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return (), (SeedIssue(path.name, 0, "file", None, "required input file is missing"),)
    except ValidationError as error:
        return (), (SeedIssue(path.name, 1, "json", None, str(error)),)


def _json_columns(rows: tuple[_ParsedRecord[ObligationRow], ...]) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    """Validate JSON string columns before SQL rendering."""
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for record in rows:
        for field, value in (("due_rule", record.value.due_rule), ("applies_when", record.value.applies_when)):
            try:
                json.loads(value)
            except json.JSONDecodeError as error:
                issues.append(SeedIssue("obligation_types.csv", record.row, field, value, error.msg))
    return tuple(issues)


def _duplicate_field_issues(
    file_name: str,
    records: tuple[CsvRecord, ...],
    field: str,
    message: str,
) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    seen: set[str] = set()
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for record in records:
        value = (record.values.get(field) or "").strip()
        if value in seen:
            issues.append(SeedIssue(file_name, record.row, field, value, message))
        seen.add(value)
    return tuple(issues)


def _unknown_site_issues(
    sites: tuple[CsvRecord, ...],
    permits: tuple[CsvRecord, ...],
) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    known_sites = {(record.values.get("code") or "").strip() for record in sites}
    return tuple(
        SeedIssue("site_permits.csv", record.row, "site_code", code, "unknown site code")
        for record in permits
        if (code := (record.values.get("site_code") or "").strip()) not in known_sites
    )


def _duplicate_permit_key_issues(records: tuple[CsvRecord, ...]) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for record in records:
        key = (
            (record.values.get("site_code") or "").strip(),
            (record.values.get("permit_type") or "").strip(),
        )
        if key in seen:
            issues.append(
                SeedIssue(
                    "site_permits.csv",
                    record.row,
                    "site_code,permit_type",
                    ",".join(key),
                    "duplicate site permit key",
                )
            )
        seen.add(key)
    return tuple(issues)


def _duplicate_era_key_issues(records: tuple[CsvRecord, ...]) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    seen: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for record in records:
        key = ((record.values.get("division") or "").strip(), (record.values.get("seq") or "").strip())
        if key in seen:
            issues.append(SeedIssue("era_template_items.csv", record.row, "division,seq", ",".join(key), "duplicate ERA template key"))
        seen.add(key)
    return tuple(issues)


def _duplicate_approval_issues(approvals: tuple[ApprovalRule, ...]) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    seen: set[str] = set()
    issues: list[SeedIssue] = []
    for index, rule in enumerate(approvals, start=1):
        if rule.code in seen:
            issues.append(SeedIssue("approval_rules.json", index, "code", rule.code, "duplicate approval rule code"))
        seen.add(rule.code)
    return tuple(issues)


def _relations(root: Path, approvals: tuple[ApprovalRule, ...]) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    """Validate duplicate and foreign-key-like seed relationships."""
    sites = read_csv(root / "sites.csv", REQUIRED_HEADERS["sites.csv"])
    permits = read_csv(root / "site_permits.csv", REQUIRED_HEADERS["site_permits.csv"])
    obligations = read_csv(root / "obligation_types.csv", REQUIRED_HEADERS["obligation_types.csv"])
    era_items = read_csv(root / "era_template_items.csv", REQUIRED_HEADERS["era_template_items.csv"])
    return (
        *_duplicate_field_issues("sites.csv", sites.records, "code", "duplicate site code"),
        *_unknown_site_issues(sites.records, permits.records),
        *_duplicate_permit_key_issues(permits.records),
        *_duplicate_field_issues("obligation_types.csv", obligations.records, "code", "duplicate obligation code"),
        *_duplicate_era_key_issues(era_items.records),
        *_duplicate_approval_issues(approvals),
    )


def _collect(root: Path) -> tuple[SeedData | None, tuple[SeedIssue, ...]]:
    """Collect all sources and return typed data only when every input is valid."""
    sites, site_issues = _parse_csv(root, "sites.csv", SiteRow)
    permits, permit_issues = _parse_csv(root, "site_permits.csv", PermitRow)
    obligations, obligation_issues = _parse_csv(root, "obligation_types.csv", ObligationRow)
    era_items, era_issues = _parse_csv(root, "era_template_items.csv", EraTemplateItemRow)
    approvals, approval_issues = _json_issue(root)
    issues = (*site_issues, *permit_issues, *obligation_issues, *era_issues, *approval_issues)
    all_issues = (*issues, *_json_columns(obligations), *_relations(root, approvals))
    if all_issues:
        return None, all_issues
    return SeedData(
        tuple(record.value for record in sites),
        tuple(record.value for record in permits),
        tuple(record.value for record in obligations),
        tuple(record.value for record in era_items),
        approvals,
    ), ()


def validate_seed(root: Path) -> tuple[SeedIssue, ...]:
    """Validate repository seed sources without creating or overwriting output."""
    _, issues = _collect(root)
    return issues


def load_seed(root: Path) -> SeedData | None:
    """Load fully typed seed data, returning no data when validation fails."""
    data, _ = _collect(root)
    return data

"""Killable process boundary for non-Tesseract OCR adapters."""

import math
import multiprocessing
import pickle
import time
from contextlib import suppress
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final, Protocol, Self, TypeGuard, cast, final

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from multiprocessing.process import BaseProcess

from PIL import Image

from .models import (
    DocumentExtractionError,
    ExtractionFailureKind,
    OcrResult,
)
from .ocr import OcrEngine

_STOP_GRACE_SECONDS: Final = 0.05
_FAILED_DETAIL: Final = "isolated OCR adapter failed"
_MESSAGE_ITEMS: Final = 2


class _Connection(Protocol):
    def send(self, obj: object) -> None: ...

    def recv(self) -> object: ...

    def poll(self, timeout: float = 0.0) -> bool: ...

    def close(self) -> None: ...


def _is_request(value: object) -> TypeGuard[tuple[Image.Image, int | float]]:
    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
        return False
    items = cast("tuple[object, ...]", value)
    return (
        len(items) == _MESSAGE_ITEMS
        and isinstance(items[0], Image.Image)
        and not isinstance(items[1], bool)
        and isinstance(items[1], (int, float))
    )


def _is_response(
    value: object,
) -> TypeGuard[tuple[bool, OcrResult | ExtractionFailureKind]]:
    if not isinstance(value, tuple):
        return False
    items = cast("tuple[object, ...]", value)
    return (
        len(items) == _MESSAGE_ITEMS
        and isinstance(items[0], bool)
        and isinstance(items[1], (OcrResult, ExtractionFailureKind))
    )


def _result_response(result: object) -> tuple[bool, OcrResult | ExtractionFailureKind]:
    if isinstance(result, OcrResult):
        return True, result
    return False, ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED


def _worker_main(engine: OcrEngine, connection: _Connection) -> None:
    try:
        while True:
            try:
                request = connection.recv()
            except (EOFError, OSError):
                return
            if request is None:
                return
            if not _is_request(request):
                connection.send((False, ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED))
                continue
            image = request[0]
            timeout_seconds = float(request[1])
            try:
                result = cast(
                    "object",
                    engine.extract(image, timeout_seconds=timeout_seconds),
                )
                connection.send(_result_response(result))
            except DocumentExtractionError as error:
                connection.send((False, error.kind))
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                connection.send((False, ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED))
    except (BrokenPipeError, EOFError, OSError):
        return
    finally:
        connection.close()


@final
class IsolatedOcrWorker:
    """Run one generic OCR engine in one killable process per document."""

    def __init__(self, engine: OcrEngine) -> None:  # noqa: D107
        self._engine = engine
        self._connection: _Connection | None = None
        self._process: BaseProcess | None = None

    def __enter__(self) -> Self:  # noqa: D105
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_exc_info: object) -> None:  # noqa: D105
        self.close()

    def _start(self) -> None:
        if self._process is not None:
            return
        try:
            _ = pickle.dumps(self._engine)
        except Exception as error:
            raise DocumentExtractionError(
                ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED,
                "OCR adapter cannot start in the isolated worker",
            ) from error
        context = multiprocessing.get_context("spawn")
        parent_connection, child_connection = context.Pipe()
        process = context.Process(
            target=_worker_main,
            args=(self._engine, child_connection),
            daemon=True,
            name="era-permit-ocr",
        )
        try:
            process.start()
        except BaseException as error:
            if process.pid is not None:
                if process.is_alive():
                    process.terminate()
                process.join()
            parent_connection.close()
            child_connection.close()
            with suppress(ValueError):
                process.close()
            raise DocumentExtractionError(
                ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED,
                "OCR adapter cannot start in the isolated worker",
            ) from error
        child_connection.close()
        self._connection = parent_connection
        self._process = process

    def _stop(self, force: bool) -> None:
        process = self._process
        connection = self._connection
        self._process = None
        self._connection = None
        if connection is not None:
            if not force:
                with suppress(BrokenPipeError, EOFError, OSError):
                    connection.send(None)
            connection.close()
        if process is None:
            return
        if force and process.is_alive():
            process.terminate()
        process.join(_STOP_GRACE_SECONDS)
        if process.is_alive():
            process.kill()
            process.join()
        process.close()

    def close(self) -> None:
        """Stop the document worker and release every process and IPC handle."""
        self._stop(force=False)

    def extract(
        self,
        image: Image.Image,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> OcrResult:
        """Enforce the supplied deadline even when the adapter ignores it."""
        if (
            timeout_seconds is None
            or not math.isfinite(timeout_seconds)
            or timeout_seconds <= 0
        ):
            raise DocumentExtractionError(
                ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_TIMEOUT,
                "document OCR budget was exhausted",
            )
        deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_seconds
        self._start()
        connection = self._connection
        process = self._process
        if connection is None or process is None:
            raise DocumentExtractionError(
                ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED,
                _FAILED_DETAIL,
            )
        try:
            connection.send((image, timeout_seconds))
        except (BrokenPipeError, EOFError, OSError, TypeError) as error:
            self._stop(force=True)
            raise DocumentExtractionError(
                ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED,
                _FAILED_DETAIL,
            ) from error
        remaining = deadline - time.monotonic()
        if remaining <= 0 or not connection.poll(remaining):
            self._stop(force=True)
            raise DocumentExtractionError(
                ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_TIMEOUT,
                "document OCR budget was exhausted",
            )
        try:
            response = connection.recv()
        except (BrokenPipeError, EOFError, OSError, TypeError) as error:
            self._stop(force=True)
            raise DocumentExtractionError(
                ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED,
                _FAILED_DETAIL,
            ) from error
        if not _is_response(response):
            self._stop(force=True)
            raise DocumentExtractionError(
                ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED,
                _FAILED_DETAIL,
            )
        succeeded, payload = response
        if succeeded and isinstance(payload, OcrResult):
            return payload
        self._stop(force=True)
        kind = payload if isinstance(payload, ExtractionFailureKind) else ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED
        raise DocumentExtractionError(kind, _FAILED_DETAIL)

def _client(headers: dict[str, str]) -> httpx2.Client:
    transport = httpx2.HTTPTransport(
        http2=True,
        retries=3,
        limits=_LIMITS,
        socket_options=_SOCKET_OPTIONS,

    return httpx2.Client(
        transport=transport,
        timeout=_TIMEOUT,
        follow_redirects=False,
        headers=headers,
    )

    return value


def _login(email: str) -> SupabaseConfig:
    url = _required_environment("SUPABASE_URL").rstrip("/")
    anon_key = _required_environment("SUPABASE_ANON_KEY")
    password = _required_environment("LOCAL_SUPABASE_TEST_PASSWORD")
    with _client({"apikey": anon_key, "Content-Type": "application/json"}) as client:
        response = client.post(
            f"{url}/auth/v1/token?grant_type=password",
            json={"email": email, "password": password},
        )
        _ = response.raise_for_status()
        session = _AuthSession.model_validate_json(response.content)
    return SupabaseConfig(
        url=url,
        project_key=anon_key,
        access_token=session.access_token,
    )


def _update(site_code: str, permit_type: PermitType, detail: str) -> PermitUpdate:
    return PermitUpdate(
        site_code=SiteCode(site_code),
        permit_type=permit_type,
        applicable=True,
        grade=None,
        detail=detail,
        items=(),
        quantity=None,
        permit_no=None,
        authority=None,
        issued_on=date(2026, 2, 3),
        conditions=None,
        status=PermitStatus.ACTIVE,
    )


def _envelope(label: str, rows: tuple[PermitUpdate, ...]) -> ImportEnvelope:
    return ImportEnvelope(
        source_name=f"{label}.csv",
        source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(label.encode()).hexdigest(),
        rows=rows,
    )

def test_local_authenticated_non_she_roles_cannot_import(email: str) -> None:
    # Given
    config = _login(email)
    client = ImportClient(config)
    envelope = _envelope(f"denied-{email}", (_update("RMC-01", PermitType.AIR_EMISSION, "denied"),))

    # When / Then
    with pytest.raises(ImportClientError) as captured:
        _ = client.apply_envelope(envelope)
    assert "42501" in str(captured.value)
    assert "?쒖꽦 SHE? ?대떦?먮쭔" in str(captured.value)
    assert config.access_token not in str(captured.value)
    assert config.project_key not in str(captured.value)


def test_local_she_import_is_transactional_and_idempotent() -> None:
    # Given
    config = _login("she-staff@example.test")
    importer = ImportClient(config)
    valid = _envelope("integration-success", (_update("RMC-01", PermitType.AIR_EMISSION, "integration-ok"),))

    # When
    first_batch = importer.apply_envelope(valid)
    replay_batch = importer.apply_envelope(valid)

    # Then
    assert replay_batch == first_batch
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {config.access_token}",
        "apikey": config.project_key,
    }
    with _client(headers) as client:
        batches_response = client.get(
            f"{config.url}/rest/v1/import_batches",
            params={"select": "id", "id": f"eq.{first_batch}"},
        )
        _ = batches_response.raise_for_status()
        batches = TypeAdapter(list[_BatchRow]).validate_json(batches_response.content)
        assert [row.id for row in batches] == [str(first_batch)]

        invalid = _envelope(
            "integration-rollback",
            (
                _update("RMC-01", PermitType.AIR_EMISSION, "must-not-persist"),
                _update("MOR-05", PermitType.CHEMICAL, "missing-target"),
            ),
        )
        with pytest.raises(ImportClientError):
            _ = importer.apply_envelope(invalid)

        permits_response = client.get(
            f"{config.url}/rest/v1/site_permits",
            params={
                "select": "detail,sites!inner(code)",
                "permit_type": "eq.air_emission",
                "sites.code": "eq.RMC-01",
            },
        )
        _ = permits_response.raise_for_status()
        permits = TypeAdapter(list[_PermitRow]).validate_json(permits_response.content)
        assert [row.detail for row in permits] == ["integration-ok"]


def test_local_concurrent_replay_returns_one_batch() -> None:
    # Given
    importer = ImportClient(_login("she-staff@example.test"))
    envelope = _envelope(
        "integration-concurrent",
        (_update("RMC-01", PermitType.AIR_PREVENTION, "concurrent-ok"),),
    )

    # When
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as executor:
        batch_ids = tuple(executor.map(importer.apply_envelope, (envelope, envelope)))

    # Then
    assert batch_ids[0] == batch_ids[1]

create view v_admin_data_quality with (security_invoker = true) as
with obligation_evidence as (
  select distinct attachment.entity_id
  from attachments attachment
  join storage.objects object
    on object.bucket_id = 'evidence'
   and object.name = attachment.storage_path
  where attachment.entity_type = 'obligation_task'
),
accessible_sites as (
  select site.id, site.code, site.name, site.division_code
  from sites site
),
unverified_obligations as (
  select 'obligation-type:' || type.code as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         'unverified_legal_duty'::text as category,
         'obligation_type'::text as entity_type,
         type.code as source_id,
         null::uuid as site_id,
         null::text as site_code,
         null::text as site_name,
         null::text as division_code,
         null::text as division_name,
         '미검증 법적 의무'::text as summary,
         concat_ws(' · ', type.title, type.legal_basis, type.notes) as detail
  from obligation_types type
  where not type.verified
    and exists (select 1 from accessible_sites)
),
permit_issues as (
  select 'site-permit:' || permit.id::text || ':' ||
           case when permit.status = 'unknown' then 'unknown' else 'missing' end as issue_id,
         'warning'::text as severity,
         case when permit.status = 'unknown' then 'unknown_permit_status' else 'missing_permit_data' end as category,
         'site_permit'::text as entity_type,
         permit.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         case when permit.status = 'unknown' then '인허가 상태 미확인' else '인허가 필수정보 확인 필요' end as summary,
         concat_ws(' · ', permit.permit_type::text, permit.source) as detail
  from site_permits permit
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = permit.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where permit.status = 'unknown'
     or (
       permit.applicable
       and permit.permit_no is null
       and permit.authority is null
       and permit.issued_on is null
     )
),
obligation_missing_evidence as (
  select 'obligation-task:' || task.id::text || ':missing-evidence' as issue_id,
         'error'::text as severity,
         'missing_evidence'::text as category,
         'obligation_task'::text as entity_type,
         task.id::text as source_id,
         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '의무 이행 증빙 누락'::text as summary,
         type.title || ' · 기한 ' || task.due_date::text as detail
  from obligation_tasks task
  join obligation_types type on type.code = task.type_code
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = task.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  left join obligation_evidence evidence on evidence.entity_id = task.id
  where type.evidence_required
    and task.status <> 'waived'
    and task.due_date <= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date
    and evidence.entity_id is null
),
obligation_overdue as (

         'error'::text as severity,
         'overdue_obligation'::text as category,

         site.id as site_id,
         site.code as site_code,
         site.name as site_name,
         division.code as division_code,
         division.name as division_name,
         '의무 이행 기한 경과'::text as summary,

  from obligation_tasks task

  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where task.status = 'planned'

),
obligation_incomplete as (

  from actions action
  join accessible_sites site on site.id = action.site_id
  join divisions division on division.code = site.division_code
  where action.status = 'done'

)

import csv
from pathlib import Path
from shutil import copytree

import pytest

from scripts.seed_builder.cli import build_seed, main

SEED_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "seed"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("file", "field", "invalid"),
    [
        ("obligation_types.csv", "source", "not_a_source"),
        ("obligation_types.csv", "anchor", "not_an_anchor"),
        ("obligation_types.csv", "times_per_period", "2147483648"),
        ("site_permits.csv", "quantity", "-2147483649"),
        ("era_template_items.csv", "likelihood", "0"),
        ("era_template_items.csv", "severity", "6"),
        ("era_template_items.csv", "seq", "2147483648"),
    ],
)
def test_invalid_database_scalar_never_overwrites_seed(
    tmp_path: Path, file: str, field: str, invalid: str,
) -> None:
    root = copytree(SEED_ROOT, tmp_path / "seed")
    path = root / file
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8-sig", newline="") as source:
        rows = list(csv.reader(source))
    rows[1][rows[0].index(field)] = invalid
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as target:
        csv.writer(target).writerows(rows)
    output = tmp_path / "seed.sql"
    _ = output.write_text("preserve-good-output", encoding="utf-8")

    result = build_seed(root)

    assert result.sql is None
    assert any(i.file == file and i.row == 2 and i.field == field for i in result.issues)
    assert main(("--root", str(tmp_path), "--output", str(output))) == 1
    assert output.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "preserve-good-output"


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("source", "row"),
    [
        ("code,division_code,name,env_contact\nRMC-01,RMC,Plant,Name,SURPLUS\n", 2),
        ("code,division_code,name,name,env_contact\nRMC-01,RMC,ORIGINAL,REPLACEMENT,Name\n", 1),
        ("code,division_code,name,env_contact\nRMC-01,RMC,Plant\n", 2),
        ('code,division_code,name,env_contact\nRMC-01,RMC,"unterminated,Name\n', 2),
        ('code,division_code,name,env_contact\nRMC-01,RMC,"Plant"garbage,Name\n', 2),
        ("code,division_code,name,env_contact,unexpected\nRMC-01,RMC,Plant,Name,x\n", 1),
    ],
)
def test_structural_csv_error_preserves_output(tmp_path: Path, source: str, row: int) -> None:
    root = copytree(SEED_ROOT, tmp_path / "seed")
    _ = (root / "sites.csv").write_text(source, encoding="utf-8")
    output = tmp_path / "seed.sql"
    _ = output.write_text("preserve-good-output", encoding="utf-8")

    result = build_seed(root)

    assert result.sql is None
    assert any(i.file == "sites.csv" and i.row == row for i in result.issues)
    assert main(("--root", str(tmp_path), "--output", str(output))) == 1
    assert output.read_text(encoding="utf-8") == "preserve-good-output"

import csv
from pathlib import Path
from shutil import copytree

from scripts.seed_builder.cli import build_seed

SEED_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "seed"


def test_known_source_reviews_are_versioned_without_correcting_source() -> None:
    result = build_seed(SEED_ROOT)
    assert result.issues == ()
    assert result.sql is not None
    assert result.sql.count("insert into source_review_issues(") == 4
    assert "신고예정" in result.sql
    assert "폐운활유" in result.sql
    assert "오기 추정" in result.sql


def test_unknown_source_review_site_prevents_generation(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    root = copytree(SEED_ROOT, tmp_path / "seed")
    path = root / "source_review_issues.csv"
    assert path.exists()
    with path.open(encoding="utf-8", newline="") as source:
        rows = list(csv.reader(source))
    rows[1][rows[0].index("site_code")] = "UNKNOWN"
    with path.open("w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as target:
        csv.writer(target).writerows(rows)
    result = build_seed(root)
    assert result.sql is None
    assert any(i.file == path.name and i.field == "site_code" for i in result.issues)

If an approach fails, try a materially different one - not a small tweak - and verify after every attempt; stale state causes most confusing failures. The smallest correct change wins: fewer new names, helpers, layers, and tests. Extract helpers only for reuse, real complexity, or a domain concept. A little duplication beats speculative abstraction. Bug fix != surrounding cleanup. Fix only issues your changes caused; report pre-existing failures as observations, not diffs.

Write only what the current correct path needs: no handlers, fallbacks, retries, or validation for impossible scenarios; validate only at system boundaries. No backward-compatibility shims for shapes that never shipped.

Default to no new tests: add one only for a user request, a subtle bug fix, or an unprotected behavioral boundary. Never add tests to a codebase with no tests; never make a test pass at the expense of correctness.

    if all(_usable_text(text) for text in text_pages):

        pages: list[ExtractedPage] = []
        total_rendered_pixels = 0
        try:
            for page_number, text in enumerate(text_pages, start=1):

                        ExtractedPage(page_number, text, ExtractionMethod.TEXT_LAYER, None)
                    )
                    continue
                rendered_page = rendered_document[page_number - 1]
                try:
                    page_width, page_height = rendered_page.get_size()
                    rendered_width = math.ceil(page_width * limits.render_scale)
                    rendered_height = math.ceil(page_height * limits.render_scale)
                    rendered_pixels = rendered_width * rendered_height
                    total_rendered_pixels += rendered_pixels
                    if (
                        max(rendered_width, rendered_height) > limits.max_rendered_dimension
                        or rendered_pixels > limits.max_rendered_pixels
                        or total_rendered_pixels > limits.max_total_rendered_pixels

                            ExtractionFailureKind.RESOURCE_LIMIT,

            ExtractionFailureKind.CORRUPT_DOCUMENT,
            "PDF page cannot be rendered locally",

    }
)


def extract_pages(
    document: DiscoveredDocument,
    ocr: OcrEngine,
    limits: ExtractionLimits = DEFAULT_EXTRACTION_LIMITS,
) -> tuple[ExtractedPage, ...]:
    """Extract 1-based page drafts without modifying or deleting the source."""
    deadline = monotonic() + limits.max_document_seconds
    contents = bounded_read.read_verified_contents(document, limits.max_source_bytes)
    extractor = _EXTRACTORS[document.mime_type]
    if _is_exact_tesseract(ocr):

                        or total_rendered_pixels > limits.max_total_rendered_pixels
                    ):
                        raise DocumentExtractionError(
                            ExtractionFailureKind.RESOURCE_LIMIT,
                            "rendered PDF dimensions exceed the extraction limit",
                        )
                    bitmap = rendered_page.render(scale=limits.render_scale)
                    try:
                        if bitmap.width * bitmap.height > limits.max_rendered_pixels:
                            raise DocumentExtractionError(
                                ExtractionFailureKind.RESOURCE_LIMIT,
                                "rendered PDF bitmap exceeds the extraction limit",
                            )
                        image = bitmap.to_pil()
                        pages.append(_ocr_page(image, page_number, ocr, deadline))
                    finally:
                        bitmap.close()
                finally:
                    rendered_page.close()
        finally:
            rendered_document.close()
    except (pypdfium2.PdfiumError, IndexError, OSError) as error:
        raise DocumentExtractionError(
            ExtractionFailureKind.CORRUPT_DOCUMENT,
            "PDF page cannot be rendered locally",
        ) from error
    return tuple(pages)


_EXTRACTORS: Final[
    Mapping[
        PermitDocumentMime,
        Callable[[bytes, OcrEngine, ExtractionLimits, float], tuple[ExtractedPage, ...]],
    ]
] = MappingProxyType(
    {
        PermitDocumentMime.PDF: _extract_pdf,
        PermitDocumentMime.JPEG: _extract_image,
        PermitDocumentMime.PNG: _extract_image,
    }
)


def extract_pages(
    document: DiscoveredDocument,
    ocr: OcrEngine,
    limits: ExtractionLimits = DEFAULT_EXTRACTION_LIMITS,
) -> tuple[ExtractedPage, ...]:
    """Extract 1-based page drafts without modifying or deleting the source."""
    deadline = monotonic() + limits.max_document_seconds
    contents = bounded_read.read_verified_contents(document, limits.max_source_bytes)
    extractor = _EXTRACTORS[document.mime_type]
    if _is_exact_tesseract(ocr):
        return extractor(contents, ocr, limits, deadline)
    with IsolatedOcrWorker(ocr) as isolated_ocr:
        return extractor(contents, isolated_ocr, limits, deadline)

from dataclasses import dataclass
from enum import StrEnum
from pathlib import Path
from typing import override


class PermitDocumentMime(StrEnum):
    """A supported permit-document MIME type proved by its file signature."""

    PDF = "application/pdf"
    JPEG = "image/jpeg"
    PNG = "image/png"


class DiscoveryFailureKind(StrEnum):
    """Operator-actionable reasons a candidate file cannot be discovered safely."""

    INBOX_MISSING = "inbox_missing"
    INBOX_NOT_DIRECTORY = "inbox_not_directory"
    INBOX_UNREADABLE = "inbox_unreadable"
    FILE_UNREADABLE = "file_unreadable"
    SYMLINK_ESCAPE = "symlink_escape"
    REPARSE_POINT = "reparse_point"
    IDENTITY_MISMATCH = "identity_mismatch"
    UNSUPPORTED_EXTENSION = "unsupported_extension"
    UNSUPPORTED_MIME = "unsupported_mime"
    EXTENSION_MISMATCH = "extension_mismatch"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class SourceProvenance:
    """Filesystem identities captured by the descriptor-bound discovery read."""

    inbox_root: Path
    root_device: int
    root_inode: int
    file_device: int
    file_inode: int
    file_modified_ns: int


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DiscoveryFailure:
    """One source path rejected before it can enter OCR or storage processing."""

    kind: DiscoveryFailureKind
    relative_path: Path | None
    detail: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class PermitDocumentDiscoveryError(Exception):
    """A complete, operator-readable collection of discovery rejections."""

    failures: tuple[DiscoveryFailure, ...]

    @override
    def __str__(self) -> str:
        """Render every rejected source path for command-line operators."""
        return "; ".join(
            f"{failure.relative_path.as_posix() if failure.relative_path else '<inbox>'}: {failure.kind.value} ({failure.detail})"
            for failure in self.failures
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DiscoveredDocument:
    """One immutable, signature-verified source document ready for extraction."""

    absolute_path: Path
    relative_path: Path
    site_code: str | None
    mime_type: PermitDocumentMime
    byte_size: int
    sha256: str
    provenance: SourceProvenance


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DocumentDiscoveryBatch:
    """A complete scan preserving both usable documents and independent failures."""

    documents: tuple[DiscoveredDocument, ...]
    failures: tuple[DiscoveryFailure, ...]


class ExtractionMethod(StrEnum):
    """How text for one source page was obtained."""

    TEXT_LAYER = "text_layer"
    OCR = "ocr"


class ExtractionFailureKind(StrEnum):
    """Safe, operator-actionable extraction failure categories."""

    SOURCE_CHANGED = "source_changed"
    SOURCE_REPARSE = "source_reparse"
    SOURCE_ROOT_CHANGED = "source_root_changed"
    RESOURCE_LIMIT = "resource_limit"
    ENCRYPTED_PDF = "encrypted_pdf"
    CORRUPT_DOCUMENT = "corrupt_document"
    UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT = "unsupported_document"
    OCR_EXECUTABLE_MISSING = "ocr_executable_missing"
    OCR_LANGUAGE_MISSING = "ocr_language_missing"
    OCR_TIMEOUT = "ocr_timeout"
    OCR_FAILED = "ocr_failed"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class DocumentExtractionError(Exception):
    """A typed extraction failure that is safe to persist for review."""

    kind: ExtractionFailureKind
    detail: str

    @override
    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return f"{self.kind.value}: {self.detail}"


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OcrResult:
    """Unconfirmed OCR output and the local engine version that produced it."""

    text: str
    engine_version: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OcrAvailability:
    """Whether the configured local OCR engine can process Korean and English."""

    available: bool
    engine_version: str | None
    languages: tuple[str, ...]
    failure_kind: ExtractionFailureKind | None
    detail: str


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ExtractedPage:
    """One 1-based source page preserved for human review."""

    page_number: int
    text: str
    method: ExtractionMethod
    engine_version: str | None

    @property
    def is_blank(self) -> bool:
        """Return whether the preserved page contains no usable text."""
        return not self.text.strip()


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class ExistingPermit:

    permit_type: str
    permit_no: str | None

class BudgetOcr:
    def extract(self, image: Image.Image, timeout_seconds: float | None = None) -> OcrResult:
        del image, timeout_seconds
        return OcrResult("ERA 2026 인허가", "budget-fake")


class ExplodingTextPage:
    def extract_text(self) -> str:
        raise AssertionError


class OversizedReader:
    is_encrypted: bool = False
    pages: tuple[ExplodingTextPage, ...] = tuple(ExplodingTextPage() for _ in range(3))


def _document(path: Path, mime_type: PermitDocumentMime) -> DiscoveredDocument:
    contents = path.read_bytes()
    root = path.parent.absolute()
    root_snapshot = safe_io.path_snapshot(root)
    file_snapshot = safe_io.path_snapshot(path.absolute())
    return DiscoveredDocument(
        absolute_path=path.absolute(),
        relative_path=Path(path.name),
        site_code=None,
        mime_type=mime_type,
        byte_size=len(contents),
        sha256=hashlib.sha256(contents).hexdigest(),
        provenance=SourceProvenance(
            inbox_root=root,
            root_device=root_snapshot.device,
            root_inode=root_snapshot.inode,
            file_device=file_snapshot.device,
            file_inode=file_snapshot.inode,
            file_modified_ns=file_snapshot.modified_ns,
        ),
    )


def test_pdf_page_limit_is_checked_before_extracting_any_page_text(
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    # Given
    path = Path(__file__).parents[1] / "fixtures" / "permit_docs" / "text-sample.pdf"
    document = _document(path, PermitDocumentMime.PDF)

    def oversized_reader(*_args: bytes, **_kwargs: bool) -> OversizedReader:
        return OversizedReader()

    monkeypatch.setattr(extract_module, "PdfReader", oversized_reader)
    limits = ExtractionLimits(max_pdf_pages=2)
    ocr = BudgetOcr()

    # When
    with pytest.raises(DocumentExtractionError) as raised:
        _ = extract_pages(document, ocr, limits)

    # Then
    assert raised.value.kind is ExtractionFailureKind.RESOURCE_LIMIT


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "limits_factory",
    [
        lambda: ExtractionLimits(max_source_bytes=-1),
        lambda: ExtractionLimits(max_image_dimension=0),
        lambda: ExtractionLimits(max_image_pixels=0),
        lambda: ExtractionLimits(max_pdf_pages=True),
        lambda: ExtractionLimits(max_rendered_dimension=0),
        lambda: ExtractionLimits(max_rendered_pixels=0),

        lambda: ExtractionLimits(max_document_seconds=-1.0),
        lambda: ExtractionLimits(max_document_seconds=0.01),
        lambda: ExtractionLimits(max_document_seconds=float("inf")),
        lambda: ExtractionLimits(
            max_document_seconds=cast("float", cast("object", "invalid"))
        ),
    ],
)
def test_extraction_limits_reject_invalid_boundary_values(
    limits_factory: Callable[[], ExtractionLimits],
) -> None:
    # Given / When
    with pytest.raises(DocumentExtractionError) as raised:
        _ = limits_factory()

    # Then
    assert raised.value.kind is ExtractionFailureKind.RESOURCE_LIMIT


def test_document_budget_stops_before_the_second_ocr_page(
    tmp_path: Path,
    monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch,
) -> None:
    # Given
    path = tmp_path / "two-pages.pdf"
    first = Image.new("RGB", (120, 80), "white")
    second = Image.new("RGB", (120, 80), "white")
    first.save(path, format="PDF", save_all=True, append_images=[second])
    ticks = iter((100.0, 100.2, 101.1))
    monkeypatch.setattr(extract_module, "monotonic", lambda: next(ticks))

        _ = extract_pages(
            _document(path, PermitDocumentMime.PDF),
            ocr,
            ExtractionLimits(max_document_seconds=1.0),
        )

    # Then
    assert raised.value.kind is ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_TIMEOUT

def malformed_pdf(objects: tuple[bytes, ...]) -> bytes:
    content = b"%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets: list[int] = []
    for number, obj in enumerate(objects, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(content))
        content += f"{number} 0 obj\n".encode() + obj + b"\nendobj\n"
    startxref = len(content)
    content += f"xref\n0 {len(objects) + 1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n".encode()
    content += b"".join(f"{offset:010d} 00000 n \n".encode() for offset in offsets)
    return content + f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objects) + 1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{startxref}\n%%EOF\n".encode()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("objects", [
    (b"<< /Type /Catalog >>",),
    (b"<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>", b"<< /Type /Pages /Count 1 /Kids [3 0 R] >>"),
])

    tmp_path: Path, objects: tuple[bytes, ...],

from __future__ import annotations

import socket
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Final

import httpx2
from pydantic import TypeAdapter, ValidationError

from scripts.importer.transaction import ImportClientError, load_config

from .field_models import SiteRef
from .http_models import (
    HashRow,
    IngestionEnvironment,
    PermitRow,
    RemovalPayload,
    SiteRow,
    StorageError,
    draft_payload,
)
from .models import ExistingPermit
from .repository import RepositoryError

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from collections.abc import Mapping

    from .draft import DocumentDraft

_TIMEOUT: Final = httpx2.Timeout(connect=5.0, read=30.0, write=10.0, pool=10.0)
_LIMITS: Final = httpx2.Limits(
    max_connections=200, max_keepalive_connections=40, keepalive_expiry=30.0
)
_SOCKET_OPTIONS: Final = [(socket.IPPROTO_TCP, socket.TCP_NODELAY, 1)]
_CONFLICT: Final = 409
_SERVER_ERROR: Final = 500


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class IngestionConfig:
    """Validated internal configuration whose representation never exposes secrets."""

    url: str
    key: str = field(repr=False)


def ingestion_config(environment: Mapping[str, str]) -> IngestionConfig:
    """Validate local credentials and reuse the importer's strict connection parser."""
    try:
        env = IngestionEnvironment.model_validate(environment)
        key = env.key.get_secret_value()
        config = load_config(
            {"SUPABASE_URL": env.url, "SUPABASE_ANON_KEY": key, "SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN": key}
        )
        return IngestionConfig(config.url, config.project_key)
    except (ValidationError, ImportClientError):
        raise RepositoryError(stage="configuration", code="invalid_supabase_settings") from None


class SupabaseDocumentRepository:
    """Service-role access restricted to ingestion, never review RPCs."""

    _config: IngestionConfig
    _transport: httpx2.BaseTransport | None

    def __init__(
        self, config: IngestionConfig, transport: httpx2.BaseTransport | None = None
    ) -> None:
        """Retain local configuration and an optional test transport."""
        self._config = config
        self._transport = transport

    def _request(
        self,
        method: str,
        endpoint: str,
        stage: str,
        content: bytes | None = None,
        mime: str = "application/json",
    ) -> httpx2.Response:
        transport = self._transport or httpx2.HTTPTransport(
            http2=True,
            retries=0,
            limits=_LIMITS,
            socket_options=_SOCKET_OPTIONS,
        )
        try:
            with httpx2.Client(
                transport=transport,
                timeout=_TIMEOUT,
                follow_redirects=False,
                headers={
                    "Authorization": f"Bearer {self._config.key}",
                    "apikey": self._config.key,
                    "Content-Type": mime,
                    "x-upsert": "false",
                },
            ) as client:
                return client.request(method, f"{self._config.url}/{endpoint}", content=content)
        except httpx2.HTTPError:
            raise RepositoryError(stage, "transport_failed", uncertain=method != "GET") from None

    @staticmethod
    def _check(response: httpx2.Response, stage: str) -> None:
        if not response.is_success:
            raise RepositoryError(
                stage, "request_rejected", uncertain=response.status_code >= _SERVER_ERROR
            )

    def known_sites(self) -> tuple[SiteRef, ...]:
        """Read site identities using Pydantic at the server trust boundary."""
        response = self._request("GET", "rest/v1/sites?select=id,code,name&order=code", "sites")
        self._check(response, "sites")
        try:
            rows = TypeAdapter(tuple[SiteRow, ...]).validate_json(response.content)
        except ValidationError:
            raise RepositoryError(stage="sites", code="invalid_response") from None
        return tuple(SiteRef(str(row.id), row.code, row.name) for row in rows)

    def existing_permits(self) -> tuple[ExistingPermit, ...]:
        """Read existing numbers for explicit review conflicts."""
        response = self._request(
            "GET", "rest/v1/site_permits?select=site_id,permit_type,permit_no", "permits"
        )
        self._check(response, "permits")
        try:
            rows = TypeAdapter(tuple[PermitRow, ...]).validate_json(response.content)
        except ValidationError:
            raise RepositoryError(stage="permits", code="invalid_response") from None
        return tuple(
            ExistingPermit(str(row.site_id), row.permit_type, row.permit_no) for row in rows
        )

    def has_hash(self, sha256: str) -> bool:
        """Find a durable row regardless of its review state."""
        response = self._request(
            "GET", f"rest/v1/permit_documents?select=id&source_sha256=eq.{sha256}&limit=1", "lookup"
        )
        self._check(response, "lookup")
        try:
            return bool(TypeAdapter(tuple[HashRow, ...]).validate_json(response.content))
        except ValidationError:
            raise RepositoryError(stage="lookup", code="invalid_response") from None

    def upload(self, path: str, contents: bytes, mime: str) -> bool:
        """Create the original only if the hash path is not already owned."""
        response = self._request(
            "POST", f"storage/v1/object/permit-documents/{path}", "upload", contents, mime
        )
        if response.status_code == _CONFLICT:
            return False
        if response.is_error:
            try:
                error = StorageError.model_validate_json(response.content)
                if str(error.status_code) == "409" or error.error == "Duplicate":
                    return False
            except ValidationError:
                self._check(response, "upload")
        self._check(response, "upload")
        return True

    def insert(self, draft: DocumentDraft) -> bool:
        """Insert one draft without changing an existing row."""
        try:
            content = draft_payload(draft).model_dump_json(exclude_none=True).encode()
        except (ValidationError, ValueError):
            raise RepositoryError(stage="insert", code="invalid_draft") from None
        response = self._request("POST", "rest/v1/permit_documents", "insert", content)
        if response.status_code == _CONFLICT and self.has_hash(draft.source_sha256):
            return False
        self._check(response, "insert")
        return True

    def remove(self, path: str) -> None:
        """Delete only the explicit newly created orphan supplied by ingestion."""
        content = RemovalPayload(prefixes=(path,)).model_dump_json().encode()
        response = self._request("DELETE", "storage/v1/object/permit-documents", "cleanup", content)
        self._check(response, "cleanup")

from PIL import Image

from scripts.permit_docs import safe_io

from scripts.permit_docs.models import (
    DiscoveredDocument,
    DocumentExtractionError,
    ExtractionFailureKind,
    OcrResult,
    PermitDocumentMime,
    SourceProvenance,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NonCooperativeOcr:
    delay_seconds: float

    def extract(
        self,
        image: Image.Image,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> OcrResult:
        del image, timeout_seconds
        time.sleep(self.delay_seconds)
        return OcrResult("too late", "sleeping-fake")


class UnpicklableOcr:
    callback: object

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.callback = lambda: None

    def extract(
        self,
        image: Image.Image,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> OcrResult:
        del image, timeout_seconds
        return OcrResult("unreachable", "unpicklable-fake")


class ExplodingOcr:
    def extract(
        self,
        image: Image.Image,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> OcrResult:
        del image, timeout_seconds
        detail = "C:\\private\\secret.txt"
        raise RuntimeError(detail)


def _document(path: Path) -> DiscoveredDocument:
    contents = path.read_bytes()
    root = path.parent.absolute()
    root_snapshot = safe_io.path_snapshot(root)
    file_snapshot = safe_io.path_snapshot(path.absolute())
    return DiscoveredDocument(
        absolute_path=path.absolute(),
        relative_path=Path(path.name),
        site_code=None,
        mime_type=PermitDocumentMime.PNG,
        byte_size=len(contents),
        sha256=hashlib.sha256(contents).hexdigest(),
        provenance=SourceProvenance(
            inbox_root=root,
            root_device=root_snapshot.device,
            root_inode=root_snapshot.inode,
            file_device=file_snapshot.device,
            file_inode=file_snapshot.inode,
            file_modified_ns=file_snapshot.modified_ns,
        ),
    )


def test_non_cooperative_ocr_is_killed_at_document_deadline(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    # Given
    path = tmp_path / "scan.png"
    Image.new("RGB", (40, 20), "white").save(path)
    existing_children = {child.pid for child in multiprocessing.active_children()}
    started_at = time.monotonic()

    # When
    with pytest.raises(DocumentExtractionError) as raised:
        _ = extract_pages(
            _document(path),
            NonCooperativeOcr(delay_seconds=3.0),
            ExtractionLimits(max_document_seconds=1.0),
        )
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started_at

    # Then
    assert raised.value.kind is ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_TIMEOUT
    assert elapsed < 1.5
    assert {child.pid for child in multiprocessing.active_children()} == existing_children


def test_unpicklable_ocr_adapter_is_rejected_as_typed_failure(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    # Given
    path = tmp_path / "scan.png"
    Image.new("RGB", (40, 20), "white").save(path)

    # When
    with pytest.raises(DocumentExtractionError) as raised:
        _ = extract_pages(_document(path), UnpicklableOcr())

    # Then
    assert raised.value.kind is ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED
    assert "callback" not in raised.value.detail


def test_child_adapter_exception_is_sanitized_and_worker_is_closed(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    # Given
    path = tmp_path / "scan.png"
    Image.new("RGB", (40, 20), "white").save(path)
    existing_children = {child.pid for child in multiprocessing.active_children()}

    # When
    with pytest.raises(DocumentExtractionError) as raised:
        _ = extract_pages(_document(path), ExplodingOcr())

    # Then
    assert raised.value.kind is ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED
    assert "secret" not in raised.value.detail
    assert {child.pid for child in multiprocessing.active_children()} == existing_children

        stage: str,
        content: bytes | None = None,
        mime: str = "application/json",
    ) -> httpx2.Response:
        transport = self._transport or httpx2.HTTPTransport(
            http2=True,
            retries=0,
            limits=_LIMITS,
            socket_options=_SOCKET_OPTIONS,
        )
        try:
            with httpx2.Client(
                transport=transport,
                timeout=_TIMEOUT,
                follow_redirects=False,
                headers={
                    "Authorization": f"Bearer {self._config.key}",
                    "apikey": self._config.key,
                    "Content-Type": mime,
                    "x-upsert": "false",
                },
            ) as client:
                return client.request(method, f"{self._config.url}/{endpoint}", content=content)
        except httpx2.HTTPError:
            raise RepositoryError(stage, "transport_failed", uncertain=method != "GET") from None

    @staticmethod
    def _check(response: httpx2.Response, stage: str) -> None:
        if not response.is_success:
            raise RepositoryError(
                stage, "request_rejected", uncertain=response.status_code >= _SERVER_ERROR
            )

    def known_sites(self) -> tuple[SiteRef, ...]:
        """Read site identities using Pydantic at the server trust boundary."""
        response = self._request("GET", "rest/v1/sites?select=id,code,name&order=code", "sites")
        self._check(response, "sites")
        try:
            rows = TypeAdapter(tuple[SiteRow, ...]).validate_json(response.content)
        except ValidationError:
            raise RepositoryError(stage="sites", code="invalid_response") from None
        return tuple(SiteRef(str(row.id), row.code, row.name) for row in rows)

    def existing_permits(self) -> tuple[ExistingPermit, ...]:
        """Read existing numbers for explicit review conflicts."""
        response = self._request(
            "GET", "rest/v1/site_permits?select=site_id,permit_type,permit_no", "permits"
        )
        self._check(response, "permits")
        try:
            rows = TypeAdapter(tuple[PermitRow, ...]).validate_json(response.content)
        except ValidationError:
            raise RepositoryError(stage="permits", code="invalid_response") from None
        return tuple(
            ExistingPermit(str(row.site_id), row.permit_type, row.permit_no) for row in rows
        )

    def has_hash(self, sha256: str) -> bool:
        """Find a durable row regardless of its review state."""
        response = self._request(
            "GET", f"rest/v1/permit_documents?select=id&source_sha256=eq.{sha256}&limit=1", "lookup"
        )
        self._check(response, "lookup")
        try:
            return bool(TypeAdapter(tuple[HashRow, ...]).validate_json(response.content))
        except ValidationError:
            raise RepositoryError(stage="lookup", code="invalid_response") from None

    def upload(self, path: str, contents: bytes, mime: str) -> bool:
        """Create the original only if the hash path is not already owned."""
        response = self._request(
            "POST", f"storage/v1/object/permit-documents/{path}", "upload", contents, mime
        )
        if response.status_code == _CONFLICT:
            return False
        if response.is_error:
            try:
                error = StorageError.model_validate_json(response.content)
                if str(error.status_code) == "409" or error.error == "Duplicate":
                    return False
            except ValidationError:
                self._check(response, "upload")
        self._check(response, "upload")
        return True

    def insert(self, draft: DocumentDraft) -> bool:
        """Insert one draft without changing an existing row."""
        try:
            content = draft_payload(draft).model_dump_json(exclude_none=True).encode()
        except (ValidationError, ValueError):
            raise RepositoryError(stage="insert", code="invalid_draft") from None
        response = self._request("POST", "rest/v1/permit_documents", "insert", content)
        if response.status_code == _CONFLICT and self.has_hash(draft.source_sha256):
            return False
        self._check(response, "insert")
        return True

    def remove(self, path: str) -> None:
        """Delete only the explicit newly created orphan supplied by ingestion."""
        content = RemovalPayload(prefixes=(path,)).model_dump_json().encode()
        response = self._request("DELETE", "storage/v1/object/permit-documents", "cleanup", content)
        self._check(response, "cleanup")

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import multiprocessing
import time
from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from PIL import Image

from scripts.permit_docs import safe_io
from scripts.permit_docs.extract import ExtractionLimits, extract_pages
from scripts.permit_docs.models import (
    DiscoveredDocument,
    DocumentExtractionError,
    ExtractionFailureKind,
    OcrResult,
    PermitDocumentMime,
    SourceProvenance,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class NonCooperativeOcr:
    delay_seconds: float

    def extract(
        self,
        image: Image.Image,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> OcrResult:
        del image, timeout_seconds
        time.sleep(self.delay_seconds)
        return OcrResult("too late", "sleeping-fake")


class UnpicklableOcr:
    callback: object

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.callback = lambda: None

    def extract(
        self,
        image: Image.Image,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> OcrResult:
        del image, timeout_seconds
        return OcrResult("unreachable", "unpicklable-fake")


class ExplodingOcr:
    def extract(
        self,
        image: Image.Image,
        timeout_seconds: float | None = None,
    ) -> OcrResult:
        del image, timeout_seconds
        detail = "C:\\private\\secret.txt"
        raise RuntimeError(detail)


def _document(path: Path) -> DiscoveredDocument:
    contents = path.read_bytes()
    root = path.parent.absolute()
    root_snapshot = safe_io.path_snapshot(root)
    file_snapshot = safe_io.path_snapshot(path.absolute())
    return DiscoveredDocument(
        absolute_path=path.absolute(),
        relative_path=Path(path.name),
        site_code=None,
        mime_type=PermitDocumentMime.PNG,
        byte_size=len(contents),
        sha256=hashlib.sha256(contents).hexdigest(),
        provenance=SourceProvenance(
            inbox_root=root,
            root_device=root_snapshot.device,
            root_inode=root_snapshot.inode,
            file_device=file_snapshot.device,
            file_inode=file_snapshot.inode,
            file_modified_ns=file_snapshot.modified_ns,
        ),
    )


def test_non_cooperative_ocr_is_killed_at_document_deadline(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    # Given
    path = tmp_path / "scan.png"
    Image.new("RGB", (40, 20), "white").save(path)
    existing_children = {child.pid for child in multiprocessing.active_children()}
    started_at = time.monotonic()

    # When
    with pytest.raises(DocumentExtractionError) as raised:
        _ = extract_pages(
            _document(path),
            NonCooperativeOcr(delay_seconds=3.0),
            ExtractionLimits(max_document_seconds=1.0),
        )
    elapsed = time.monotonic() - started_at

    # Then
    assert raised.value.kind is ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_TIMEOUT
    assert elapsed < 1.5
    assert {child.pid for child in multiprocessing.active_children()} == existing_children


def test_unpicklable_ocr_adapter_is_rejected_as_typed_failure(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    # Given
    path = tmp_path / "scan.png"
    Image.new("RGB", (40, 20), "white").save(path)

    # When
    with pytest.raises(DocumentExtractionError) as raised:
        _ = extract_pages(_document(path), UnpicklableOcr())

    # Then
    assert raised.value.kind is ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED
    assert "callback" not in raised.value.detail


def test_child_adapter_exception_is_sanitized_and_worker_is_closed(tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    # Given
    path = tmp_path / "scan.png"
    Image.new("RGB", (40, 20), "white").save(path)
    existing_children = {child.pid for child in multiprocessing.active_children()}

    # When
    with pytest.raises(DocumentExtractionError) as raised:
        _ = extract_pages(_document(path), ExplodingOcr())

    # Then
    assert raised.value.kind is ExtractionFailureKind.OCR_FAILED
    assert "secret" not in raised.value.detail
    assert {child.pid for child in multiprocessing.active_children()} == existing_children

from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from scripts.permit_docs import safe_io
from scripts.permit_docs.discover import discover_document_batch


def test_oversized_discovery_stops_before_descriptor_read(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    source = tmp_path / "large.pdf"
    with source.open("wb") as target:
        _ = target.write(b"%PDF-1.4\n")
        _ = target.truncate(65 * 1024 * 1024)

    def unexpected_open(_: Path) -> int:
        pytest.fail("oversized source must be rejected before opening or hashing it")

    monkeypatch.setattr(safe_io, "open_read_descriptor", unexpected_open)
    batch = discover_document_batch(tmp_path)
    assert batch.documents == ()
    assert [failure.kind.value for failure in batch.failures] == ["resource_limit"]


def test_unsupported_extension_never_reads_contents(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    _ = (tmp_path / "unsupported.bin").write_bytes(b"%PDF-1.4\n")

    def unexpected_open(_: Path) -> int:
        pytest.fail("unsupported extension must not open or hash the source")

    monkeypatch.setattr(safe_io, "open_read_descriptor", unexpected_open)
    batch = discover_document_batch(tmp_path)
    assert batch.documents == ()
    assert [failure.kind.value for failure in batch.failures] == ["unsupported_extension"]

-- ERA 환경 플랫폼 초기 스키마
-- 원칙: 모든 현장 데이터는 site_id를 가진다. 권한 범위는 RLS, 상태 전이는 RPC 함수로 통제한다.

create extension if not exists pgcrypto;

-- =========================================================
-- 1. enum
-- =========================================================
create type app_role as enum (
  'ceo','division_head','division_exec','cso','she_lead','she_staff',
  'dept_head','plant_manager','env_officer','cooperator'
);
create type role_scope as enum ('company','division','site');

create type permit_type as enum (
  'air_emission',      -- 대기 배출사업장(종별)
  'air_prevention',    -- 대기 방지시설
  'fugitive_dust',     -- 비산먼지 발생사업 신고
  'air_monitoring',    -- 측정기기(IoT / TMS)
  'water_emission',    -- 폐수 배출사업장(종별)
  'nonpoint_source',   -- 비점오염원 설치신고
  'river_water_use',   -- 하천수 사용허가
  'waste_general',     -- 사업장(일반)폐기물 배출자
  'waste_designated',  -- 지정폐기물
  'soil_specific',     -- 특정토양오염관리대상시설
  'noise_vibration',   -- 소음·진동 배출시설
  'groundwater',       -- 지하수 이용(관정)
  'chemical'           -- 화학물질
);
create type permit_status as enum ('active','pending','revoked','unknown');

create type frequency as enum (
  'weekly','monthly','bimonthly','quarterly','semiannual','annual','triennial','event'
);
create type obligation_source as enum ('law','internal');
create type task_status as enum ('planned','done','confirmed','waived');

create type era_condition as enum ('normal','abnormal','emergency');
create type env_media as enum ('air','water','waste','soil','noise','groundwater','chemical','resource','other');
create type era_status as enum ('draft','submitted','reviewed','approved','returned');

create type inspection_kind as enum ('self','she','authority','third_party');
create type check_result as enum ('ok','ng','na');
create type sanction_type as enum ('none','warning','improvement_order','fine','suspension','other');

create type action_source as enum ('era','finding','incident','obligation','other');
create type action_status as enum ('open','in_progress','done','closed','returned');

-- =========================================================
-- 2. 조직
-- =========================================================
create table divisions (
  code        text primary key,              -- RMC / AGG / MOR
  name        text not null,                 -- 레미콘 / 골재 / 몰탈
  dept_name   text not null,                 -- 환경관리 실무부서
  exec_title  text not null,                 -- 담당임원 직책
  site_head_title text not null default '공장장',
  sort        int  not null default 0
);

create table sites (
  id            uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  code          text unique not null,        -- RMC-01 등
  division_code text not null references divisions(code),
  name          text not null,
  env_contact   text,                        -- 취합표 '담당자' 원문
  address       text,
  active        boolean not null default true,
  notes         text,
  created_at    timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table profiles (
  id         uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  name       text not null,
  email      text not null unique,
  phone      text,
  title      text,
  active     boolean not null default true,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table role_assignments (
  id            uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id       uuid not null references profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  role          app_role not null,
  scope         role_scope not null,
  division_code text references divisions(code),
  site_id       uuid references sites(id),
  created_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint scope_target check (
    (scope = 'company'  and division_code is null and site_id is null) or
    (scope = 'division' and division_code is not null and site_id is null) or
    (scope = 'site'     and site_id is not null)
  ),
  unique (user_id, role, scope, division_code, site_id)
);

-- =========================================================
-- 3. 권한 헬퍼 (RLS에서 사용)
-- =========================================================
create or replace function my_site_ids() returns setof uuid
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select s.id
  from sites s
  join role_assignments ra on ra.user_id = auth.uid()
  where ra.scope = 'company'
     or (ra.scope = 'division' and ra.division_code = s.division_code)
     or (ra.scope = 'site' and ra.site_id = s.id)
$$;

create or replace function can_read_site(p_site uuid) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select exists (select 1 from my_site_ids() x where x = p_site)
$$;

-- 해당 사업장을 범위에 포함하는 지정 역할을 가졌는가
create or replace function has_site_role(p_site uuid, p_roles app_role[]) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select exists (
    select 1
    from role_assignments ra
    join sites s on s.id = p_site
    where ra.user_id = auth.uid()
      and ra.role = any(p_roles)
      and (ra.scope = 'company'
        or (ra.scope = 'division' and ra.division_code = s.division_code)
        or (ra.scope = 'site' and ra.site_id = s.id))
  )
$$;

create or replace function has_role(p_roles app_role[]) returns boolean
language sql stable security definer set search_path = public as $$
  select exists (select 1 from role_assignments where user_id = auth.uid() and role = any(p_roles))
$$;

-- 현장 입력 역할 (라인조직). company 범위 역할(CSO·SHE팀)은 현장 데이터를 쓰지 않는다.
create or replace function field_roles() returns app_role[]
language sql immutable as $$ select array['env_officer','plant_manager','dept_head']::app_role[] $$;

-- =========================================================
-- 4. M1 인허가
-- =========================================================
create table site_permits (
  id           uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  site_id      uuid not null references sites(id),
  permit_type  permit_type not null,
  applicable   boolean not null,             -- 취합표 O/X
  grade        text,                         -- '4종', '5종' 등
  detail       text,                         -- 처리방식, 비고(일부설비 면제 등)
  items        text[] not null default '{}', -- 폐기물 종류 목록
  quantity     int,                          -- 지하수 관정 수
  permit_no    text,
  authority    text,                         -- 허가·신고 기관
  issued_on    date,
  conditions   text,                         -- 허가조건
  status       permit_status not null default 'active',
  source       text not null default 'manual', -- 'seed:2026-07 취합표' 등
  updated_by   uuid references profiles(id),
  updated_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (site_id, permit_type)
);

create table permit_changes (
  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  site_id         uuid not null references sites(id),
  permit_id       uuid references site_permits(id),
  change_kind     text not null check (change_kind in ('신규','변경신고','변경허가','폐지')),
  description     text not null,
  filed_on        date,
  approval_doc_no text,                      -- 전자결재 문서번호 (전결표 3번)
  created_by      uuid references profiles(id),
  created_at      timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- 환경기술인 선임 이력 (전결표 4번, 교육 의무의 기준일)
create table env_officer_appointments (
  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  site_id         uuid not null references sites(id),
  person_name     text not null,
  profile_id      uuid references profiles(id),
  media           env_media[] not null default '{}', -- 대기·수질 등
  appointed_on    date not null,
  ended_on        date,
  new_edu_done_on date,                      -- 신규교육 이수일
  last_edu_done_on date,                     -- 최근 보수교육 이수일
  approval_doc_no text,
  created_at      timestamptz not null default now()
);

-- =========================================================
-- 5. M2 법적 준수
-- =========================================================
create table obligation_types (
  code              text primary key,
  media             env_media not null,
  title             text not null,
  legal_basis       text,
  description       text,
  source            obligation_source not null,
  frequency         frequency not null,
  times_per_period  int not null default 1,
  due_rule          jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb, -- {"day":15} {"month":2,"day":28}
  applies_when      jsonb not null,                     -- 적용 조건 (04_M2 참고)
  anchor            text not null default 'calendar' check (anchor in ('calendar','appointment')),
  evidence_required boolean not null default true,
  evidence_hint     text,
  owner_role        app_role not null default 'env_officer',
  confirm_role      app_role not null default 'plant_manager',
  verified          boolean not null default false,     -- false면 자동 일정 생성 금지
  verified_by       uuid references profiles(id),
  verified_at       timestamptz,
  notes             text
);

create table obligation_tasks (
  id            uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  site_id       uuid not null references sites(id),
  type_code     text not null references obligation_types(code),
  period_label  text not null,               -- '2027-1H', '2027-03' 등
  due_date      date not null,
  status        task_status not null default 'planned',
  done_on       date,
  done_by       uuid references profiles(id),
  confirmed_by  uuid references profiles(id),
  confirmed_at  timestamptz,
  waive_reason  text,
  note          text,
  created_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (site_id, type_code, due_date)
);

-- 화면용: 표시 상태 계산 (planned 중 D-30 이내 = due_soon, 기한 경과 = overdue)
create or replace view v_obligation_tasks with (security_invoker = true) as
select t.*,
       ot.title, ot.media, ot.verified,
       s.name as site_name, s.division_code,
       case
         when t.status in ('done','confirmed','waived') then t.status::text
         when t.due_date < (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date then 'overdue'
         when t.due_date <= (now() at time zone 'Asia/Seoul')::date + 30 then 'due_soon'
         else 'planned'
       end as display_status
from obligation_tasks t
join obligation_types ot on ot.code = t.type_code
join sites s on s.id = t.site_id;

-- 적용 조건 판정
create or replace function obligation_applies(p_site uuid, p_rule jsonb) returns boolean
language plpgsql stable as $$
declare
  v_ok boolean;
begin
  if coalesce((p_rule->>'all_sites')::boolean, false) then
    return true;
  end if;
  select exists (
    select 1 from site_permits p
    where p.site_id = p_site
      and p.applicable
      and p.permit_type = (p_rule->>'permit_type')::permit_type
      and (not (p_rule ? 'grade_in')
           or p.grade = any (array(select jsonb_array_elements_text(p_rule->'grade_in'))))
      and (not (p_rule ? 'detail_excludes')
           or coalesce(p.detail,'') not ilike '%' || (p_rule->>'detail_excludes') || '%')
      and (not (p_rule ? 'detail_includes')
           or coalesce(p.detail,'') ilike '%' || (p_rule->>'detail_includes') || '%')
  ) into v_ok;
  return v_ok;
end $$;

-- 달력 기준 의무 일정 생성 (verified 항목만). 여러 번 실행해도 중복 생성하지 않는다.
create or replace function generate_obligation_tasks(p_year int) returns int
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare
  r_site record; r_type record;
  v_dates date[]; v_labels text[]; d date; i int; m int; v_count int := 0; v_day int;
begin
  for r_type in select * from obligation_types where verified and anchor = 'calendar' and frequency <> 'event' and frequency <> 'triennial' loop
    v_dates := '{}'; v_labels := '{}';
    v_day := nullif(r_type.due_rule->>'day','')::int;
    if r_type.frequency = 'weekly' then
      d := make_date(p_year,1,1) + ((7 - extract(dow from make_date(p_year,1,1))::int) % 7); -- 첫 일요일
      while extract(year from d) = p_year loop
        v_dates := v_dates || d; v_labels := v_labels || to_char(d,'IYYY-"W"IW'); d := d + 7;
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'monthly' then
      for m in 1..12 loop
        if r_type.times_per_period = 2 then
          v_dates := v_dates || make_date(p_year,m,15); v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s-1', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
          v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,m,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s-2', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
        elsif v_day is not null then
          v_dates := v_dates || make_date(p_year,m,v_day); v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
        else
          v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,m,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-%s', p_year, lpad(m::text,2,'0'));
        end if;
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'bimonthly' then
      for m in 2..12 by 2 loop
        v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,m,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-B%s', p_year, m/2);
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'quarterly' then
      for i in 1..4 loop
        v_dates := v_dates || (make_date(p_year,i*3,1) + interval '1 month - 1 day')::date; v_labels := v_labels || format('%s-Q%s', p_year, i);
      end loop;
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'semiannual' then
      v_dates := array[make_date(p_year,6,30), make_date(p_year,12,31)];
      v_labels := array[format('%s-1H',p_year), format('%s-2H',p_year)];
    elsif r_type.frequency = 'annual' then
      v_dates := array[make_date(p_year, coalesce((r_type.due_rule->>'month')::int,12),
                                         coalesce(v_day, case when coalesce((r_type.due_rule->>'month')::int,12) = 2 then 28 else 31 end))];
      v_labels := array[p_year::text];
    end if;

    for r_site in select id from sites where active loop
      if obligation_applies(r_site.id, r_type.applies_when) then
        for i in 1..coalesce(array_length(v_dates,1),0) loop
          insert into obligation_tasks(site_id, type_code, period_label, due_date)
          values (r_site.id, r_type.code, v_labels[i], v_dates[i])
          on conflict (site_id, type_code, due_date) do nothing;
          if found then v_count := v_count + 1; end if;
        end loop;
      end if;
    end loop;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end $$;

-- 선임일 기준 의무(환경기술인 신규·보수교육) 일정 생성
create or replace function generate_appointment_tasks() returns int
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$
declare r record; v_count int := 0; v_due date;
begin
  for r in
    select a.*, ot.code as type_code, ot.frequency
    from env_officer_appointments a
    cross join obligation_types ot
    where a.ended_on is null and ot.verified and ot.anchor = 'appointment'
  loop
    if r.frequency = 'event' and r.new_edu_done_on is null then
      v_due := r.appointed_on + interval '1 year' - interval '1 day';   -- 신규교육
    elsif r.frequency = 'triennial' and coalesce(r.last_edu_done_on, r.new_edu_done_on) is not null then
      v_due := coalesce(r.last_edu_done_on, r.new_edu_done_on) + interval '3 years'; -- 보수교육
    else
      continue;
    end if;
    insert into obligation_tasks(site_id, type_code, period_label, due_date, note)
    values (r.site_id, r.type_code, r.person_name, v_due, '선임 ' || r.appointed_on)
    on conflict (site_id, type_code, due_date) do nothing;
    if found then v_count := v_count + 1; end if;
  end loop;
  return v_count;
end $$;
